title: Cefazolin for Methicillin-Susceptible Staphylococcus aureus Bacteremia
authors: The Staphylococcus aureus Network Adaptive Platform (SNAP) Trial Group
abstract:
Cefazolin for MSSA Bacteremia
In this trial, cefazolin was noninferior to flucloxacillin or cloxacillin with respect to 90-day mortality in patients with methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia and had fewer nephrotoxic effects.

title: Stemness as the Engine of Checkpoint Durability
abstract:
Checkpoint Inhibition with Preservation of Progenitor T Cells
The clinical benefits of checkpoint inhibitors in the treatment of cancer often wane. A preclinical study points to a potential strategy for a more durable effect.

title: Management of Differentiated Thyroid Cancer
abstract:
Management of Differentiated Thyroid Cancer
This review of the evolving management of differentiated thyroid cancer highlights overdiagnosis of low-risk disease, dynamic risk stratification, active surveillance or ablation, targeted therapies, and active patient involvement.

title: Chromoblastomycosis
abstract:
Chromoblastomycosis
A 38-year-old pregnant former agricultural worker was referred to the dermatology clinic for evaluation of a long-standing, itchy lesion on her abdomen. Histopathological analysis showed thick-walled, brown, septate spores.

title: Case 17-2026: A 74-Year-Old Man with Pancytopenia
abstract:
A Man with Pancytopenia
A 74-year-old man with a recent orthotopic heart transplantation was admitted to the hospital because of persistent pancytopenia that resulted in serial transfusions of packed red cells. A diagnosis was made.
